culprit_citations.quoted_text: Total roll-forward line shows Fair Value at December 31, 2025 of 58,372 for controlled affiliated investment activity.

findings.detail: The extracted fair-value sum includes the 58,372 controlled-affiliate roll-forward total, causing the 3,405,689 extract sum to exceed the 3,347,317 filing total by exactly 58,372.

rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation shows the filing schedule total and companyfacts anchor are 3,347,317 thousand, while the extracted position sum is 3,405,689 thousand. The 58,372 thousand overshoot exactly matches the controlled-affiliate roll-forward total at table 45 row 3, not an additional position to add on top of Total Investments.
